_comment: Codex: Space Marines (11th edition) stratagems + detachment rules, generated by
scripts/40kdc/curate-from-wahapedia.mjs from the Wahapedia snapshot in
printed text. windows were INFERRED from WHEN (see _window_review) unless the codex
implementation pass CONFIRMED them (CONFIRMED_WINDOWS in the script, marked [CONFIRMED]).
duration_phrase is editorial (see orks_codex_11e.json; DURATION_PHRASES in the script).
Boarding Actions detachments are out of scope (owner decision D3).

detachments.name: Gladius Task Force
detachments.rule_text:
Codex Discipline
You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.
detachments.legend: THE PERFECTLY BALANCED BLADE OF A GLADIUS TASK FORCE CAN SLAY ANY FOE

detachments.name: Ironstorm Spearhead
detachments.rule_text:
Ironstorm Auto-targeters
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units’ (excluding walker units) ranged attacks can:
• Re-roll one hit roll.
• Re-roll one wound roll.
detachments.legend: SPACE MARINE TANKS DEPLOY AT SQUADRON STRENGTH TO PUNCH THROUGH ENEMY LINES

detachments.name: Stormlance Task Force
detachments.rule_text:
Lightning-fast Strike
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +2" M.
detachments.legend: SPACE MARINE BIKE SQUADRONS, SPEEDERS AND LIGHT ARMOUR RACE INTO BATTLE

detachments.name: Gauntlet Task Force
detachments.rule_text:
Combined Deployment
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn:
• While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
detachments.legend: SQUADS OF BATTLE-BROTHERS RACE INTO BATTLE ABOARD INDOMITABLE ARMOURED TRANSPORTS

detachments.name: Phobos Shadow Force
detachments.rule_text:
Shadow Masters
When a friendly Phobos or Scout SQUAD unit has shot:
• Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.
• Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
detachments.legend: PHOBOS-ARMOURED STEALTH ADEPTS HUNT THEIR ENEMIES UNSEEN

detachments.name: Tacticus Attack Force
detachments.rule_text:
Wrath of the Chapter
Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.
detachments.legend: CHARGING INTO BATTLE, TACTICUS-ARMOURED BATTLE-BROTHERS CUT A BLOODY PATH THROUGH THE FOE

detachments.name: Phobos Shock Force
detachments.rule_text:
Vanguard Ambushers
At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.
detachments.legend: EXPLODING FROM THE SHADOWS, PHOBOS-ARMOURED KILLERS CATCH THE FOE IN A BLOODY AMBUSH

detachments.name: Terminator Storm Force
detachments.rule_text:
Death Blow
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.
detachments.legend: TERMINATOR-ARMOURED FIRST COMPANY VETERANS UNLEASH THEIR MIGHT UPON THE BATTLEFIELD

detachments.name: Assault Brethren
detachments.rule_text:
Assault Mastery
You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.
detachments.legend: THE CHAPTER’S CLOSE-COMBAT SPECIALISTS TEAR INTO THE FOE WITH LETHAL INTENT

detachments.name: Gravis Linebreaker Force
detachments.rule_text:
Walking Fortress
In a turn a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit’s ranged attacks:
• Do not have [Heavy].
• Have +1 to hit rolls.
detachments.legend: RELENTLESS AND UNSTOPPABLE, GRAVIS-ARMOURED WARRIORS MARCH OUT ON THE ATTACK

detachments.name: Devastator Brethren
detachments.rule_text:
Devastator Mastery
You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.
detachments.legend: HEAVILY ARMED SPACE MARINES RAIN THUNDEROUS DEATH UPON THE EMPEROR’S FOES

detachments.name: Gravis Siege Force
detachments.rule_text:
Indomitable Defence
While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
detachments.legend: GRAVIS-ARMOURED SPACE MARINES SEIZE AND HOLD VITAL STRATEGIC SITES AGAINST ANY THREAT

detachments.name: Tactical Brethren
detachments.rule_text:
Tactical Mastery
You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.
detachments.legend: A CORE OF TACTICALLY VERSATILE WARRIORS STRENGTHENS THE SPACE MARINE BATTLE LINE

detachments.name: Ironclad Champions
detachments.rule_text:
Enduring Vengeance
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
detachments.legend: THE CHAPTER’S DEATHLESS DREADNOUGHT CHAMPIONS STRIDE OUT TO WAR

detachments.name: Tacticus Firestorm Force
detachments.rule_text:
Codex Fire-patterns
Friendly Tacticus units’ [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.
detachments.legend: TACTICUS-ARMOURED WARRIORS LAY DOWN DISCIPLINED FIRE TO DOMINATE THE BATTLEFIELD

stratagems.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Masters of the art of long-ranged warfare, these warriors unleash utter devastation upon their enemies.

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground to leave enemies floundering, before surging back and driving them from the field in disarray.

stratagems.name: A WORTHY DEATH
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Those Space Marines who specialise in close assault are ready to fight to their last breath and beyond to cut down more foes.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Relentless assault training allows these warriors to focus their already impressive might into a truly devastating close-quarters onslaught.

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: The tenets of the Codex Astartes allow for unorthodox use of combat tactics and the employment of divergent doctrines if doing so will lead to victory.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units).
stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
• M.
• BS.
• Hit rolls and wound rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crews of their vehicles are slain.

stratagems.name: LAYERED CERAMITE
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: The labours of artisans in the Chapter armoury now bear fruit.

stratagems.name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units) is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Exhaustive tactical training aids Space Marine gunners in exploiting any weakness in their targets’ armour.

stratagems.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
• If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move.
• Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Employing their steeds’ pace to utmost effect, these warriors stay ever on the move.

stratagems.name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit is selected to make an advance move.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Speed and shock are key to the Space Marine way of war: never more so than on rapid-strike missions.

stratagems.name: HURTLING TARGETS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: With nerves of steel and transhuman reactions, the Space Marines jink and weave cooly through incoming fire.

stratagems.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: There is no time to rest upon laurels while any portion of the Emperor’s realm remains in enemy hands.

stratagems.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit that has an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit embarked within it.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: The advanced mechanised assault tactics employed by this force allow ground to be seized rapidly while on the move.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a Transport is selected to move.
stratagems.effect:
While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.
This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Bursting out of their transport, the Space Marines are already on the move before their foes can react.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: At an opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.

stratagems.name: MORTIS SNARES
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout Squad unit.
stratagems.effect:
If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6:
• On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.
• That objective is no longer snared.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: These stealth operatives lace the battlefield with explosive devices that trigger by mico-auspex and las-wire when foes blunder into them.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden Phobos unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
• +1 S.
• [Lethal Hits].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.effect: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Even amidst the fiercest fighting, this squad retains sight of their assigned mission.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
• [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
• Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Poised and aware of their foes’ every move, these warriors strike at the most tactically advantageous moment.

stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Phobos unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:

• Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Seemingly with the speed of instinct, these warriors reposition in response to the enemy’s movements.

stratagems.name: UMBRAL EVASION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Phobos unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: A combination of technological arcana and expert training help these warriors to evade the eyes of the foe.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: The combination of Tactical Dreadnought armour and transhuman physiology is redoubtable indeed.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• [Lethal Hits].
• [Sustained Hits 1].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Cumulative centuries of military experience help these veterans’ firepower hit home with murderous precision.

stratagems.name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged adeptus astartes terminator unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Armoured gunships are often assigned to swoop in and relocate Terminator Squads in the midst of battle.

When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
• For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Throwing their armoured mass into an assault, a Space Marine in Gravis armour can crush and trample their foe.

stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.

stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Gravis assault tactics stipulate a relentless advance coupled with unfaltering firepower.

stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Booming war cries through his vox-amplifiers, this Dreadnought rampages through the terrified foe.

stratagems.name: UPSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Mobile.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the relentless advance of an Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
• [lethal hits].
• Or: [Sustained Hits 1].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged Tacticus unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have:
• [Close-Quarters].
• [Ignores Cover].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Transhuman skill and reaction times render these Space Marines’ firearms as deadly up close as any blade.

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
• [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
• Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
